description: Submit feedback on a previously generated UI component or page template. This helps UIForge learn your preferences and improve future generations.

component_type.description: Type of component (e.g., button, form, layout)

feedback_type.description: Type of feedback: explicit (user-provided) or implicit (behavior-based)

generation_id.description: The ID of the generation to provide feedback for

issues.description: List of identified issues in the generated component

strengths.description: List of identified strengths in the generated component

name: submit_feedback
